verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a Sandbox mode for testing an integration before going live, covering most functionality including app tokens, webhooks, and the WebSDK. Nothing in the evidence describes test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically trigger pass, fail, or review outcomes. Exercising specific outcomes is only loosely implied by manual approve/reject of applicants, which is not tied to the sandbox. Missing for 10: documented test documents/personas/magic values, deterministic outcome simulation for pass/fail/review, independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox outcome testing.
